                                               ORDINANCE

BE I T ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing the B3-3 Comniunity Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 17-G in the area bounded by

       The alley next north of and parallel to West Morse Avenue; A line 300 feet east of and parallel to
       North Greenview Avenue; West Morse Avenue; and a line 250 feet east of and parallel to North
       Greenvievv Avenue

to those of a C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
